reasons: Datadog system.load.5 is the 5-minute system load average, and the OTel metric system.cpu.load_average.5m (gauge, {thread}) measures the same quantity, so the metric mapping is correct.

The Datadog query has no explicit space aggregator, so it uses Datadog's default average across the in-scope series. The candidate wraps the selector in sum(), which adds the load across hosts and gives a different value. The expression should use avg() instead.
The scope template variable has no prefix and defaults to *, so dropping it is correct. The outcome should stay translated, not blocked.
